The '''Senate Overflow Offices''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] located in the [[Administrative Sector]] that contained offices for [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it was the location of a [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist attack]].
